name: God and Country
title: Daredevil #232
desc:
Matt helps Karen kick her drug habit. Kingpin hires a deranged Super Soldier to go after Daredevil.

Nuke was hired by Kingpin to kill Daredevil.

Urich hires Glorianna as photographer and goes for an interview at the jail with the nurse who tried to kill him at the hospital some issues ago, sent by Kingpin. One of the guards shoots the "nurse" in the head before she could say anything.

Nuke is dropped by a chopper in the middle of Hell's Kitchen and starts to shoot everyone trying to call for Daredevil, and he succeeds.
